opportunities.point: Management stated that post Phase-3 expansion, a long-term blended EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 85,000 should be sustainable.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Secondly, looking at our overall long-term portfolio and capacity mix and the additional traction with exports and improving operating leverage, we believe post Phase-3 expansion, a long-term EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 85,000 per ton should be..." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Management expects the company's total installed capacity to increase to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "The board has approved a new Phase-3 expansion to add specialized Magnet Winding Wires manufacturing capacity, and which is expected to increase the company's total installed capacity to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company intends to spend up to Rs. 1,850 million or Rs. 185 crores to finance the Phase-3 expansion, including purchasing 10 acres of land in Supa.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The company intends to spend up to Rs. 1,850 million or Rs. 185 crores to finance this expansion, which also includes he purchase of an additional 10 acres of land in Supa and it will be funded with a combination of internal accruals and long-term debt." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The new Phase-3 capacity expansion is expected to be funded by a mix of debt and internal accruals, with expenses incurred primarily in FY28.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "This project will be funded by a mix of debt and internal accruals. We expect the majority of these expenses to be incurred in FY '28 though a smaller upfront portion would likely be spent during H2 of FY '27." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)
